body.en: v0.16.11 shipped without an AppImage; this release has one again. Its window now draws on Ubuntu 26.04, Fedora 45 and Arch instead of staying blank. Thanks to @stefanbringuier.
body.zh: v0.16.11 发布时缺少 AppImage，此版本重新提供。它的窗口现在可以在 Ubuntu 26.04、Fedora 45 和 Arch 上正常绘制，不再保持空白。感谢 @stefanbringuier。

body.en: In the focused Terminal panel, ⌘W closes the terminal, not the document or window, and asks first if a command is still running. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
body.zh: 在聚焦的终端面板中，⌘W 会关闭终端，而不是文档或窗口；如果有命令仍在运行，会先询问。感谢 @ajay-mk。

fixes.en: The Terminal panel closes when its last shell exits. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
fixes.zh: 终端面板会在最后一个 shell 退出后关闭。感谢 @ajay-mk。

fixes.en: Lint and the i18n guard run on Windows development setups. Thanks to @skytheacademic.
fixes.zh: Lint 和 i18n 检查可以在 Windows 开发环境中运行。感谢 @skytheacademic。
